bugs.description: Malformed JSON error retained payload text in native SyntaxError; provider forwards error and stack to client reporting. Replaced with fresh payload-free error, no cause. Direct error inspection fails before and passes after.

Native res.json SyntaxError retained response payload through ReconcilerReloadError.originalError and downstream reporter. Removed originalError from only invalid-json branch; direct full reporter regression fails before and passes after.

canPut ignored disposal and dispatch could drain store-owned edits into an inert reconciler. Post-disposal watch registration also created a promise no future action could settle. Disposal now gates canPut and late watches resolve cancelled.
Nested replay close incorrectly dropped remote flag; nested deferred startTracking lost release request and left author undo paused. Both fail-before regressions now pass.
Batch-wide duplicate-claim tracking rejected successive identity-preserving option/schedule replacements. Duplicate detection is now per payload, with removed-in-batch and ownership checks unchanged.

New form birth anchored to retained form before evacuation into new module silently orphaned it and internal replay threw. Projected order now tracks actual insertion availability and final relocation/reorder.

User property, role and persona existing-item reorder silently emitted no diff. With no move dialect, now refuses using same invariant as organization collections. Three failed-before regressions pass.

Final-input cleanup omitted searchFirst from meaningful action settings and silently disabled authored automatic Search. Delegation to existing domain projector preserves zero-prompt Search and after-submit destination. Admitted regression failed before and passes after.

addForm/moveForm wrote entities or removed source membership before missing anchor refusal, orphaning live forms during stale replay. Both now preflight destination anchor and self-anchor before writes.

First case-operation write/link with omitted after calculated index zero and was mistakenly treated as missing explicit anchor. Fixed guard to distinguish omitted/null append/front from a missing named anchor. Fail-before regression passes.

Stale add/move anchor and add under a leaf caused orphan entities and fieldParent rebuild exceptions. Reducers now reject invalid parent/anchor before structural or catalog writes; three failures reproduced and all23 field mutation tests pass after fix.

text to select conversion with missing option source was acknowledged by commit as successful unchanged doc because reducer skipped reconciliation. Target admission now refuses select birth without complete source. Missing-source regression failed before and23conversion tests pass after.

bugs.bug: Flattening sectioned form with duplicate root-bound IDs returned ok plan rejected by commit gate. Added root identifier preflight with actionable rename refusal.
bugs.evidence: section-flatten-before.log fails expected refusal; sections-after.log passes29

docsNeeded: Testing diagnostics: inspect actual Error message/stack/cause when reporting owns an Error; JSON.stringify drops nonenumerable properties and cannot prove payload absence.
Reconciler disposal is terminal for command ownership: a late dispatch leaves the store queue intact and a late save watch resolves cancelled.
Connect and document subscription tests now require admitted baseline documents and actual planner/gate transitions; fieldless/stray cross-mode apps are not reachable fixtures.
